package.intro: The €1,100 package includes everything your online store needs to run correctly, securely, and without daily management worries.
features: Minimum interventions (up to 2 hours per month) for fixes, changes, or small improvements.
Registration of up to 25 new products per month.
Full updates of the theme and all plugins to ensure security and full site compatibility.
Backup before every update for maximum data protection.
Post-update verification to ensure everything works perfectly.
package.outro: This way you will have a partner who constantly takes care of your e-commerce, preventing problems before they arise and saving you time and money on unexpected failures or emergency interventions.
package.note: The price does not include the purchase or renewal of licenses for premium themes, plugins, or other third-party services. If needed, you will be informed and asked for approval before any purchase.
